record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page by running `node build.js` from inside `site/`. It has to be run from there because the script uses relative paths. It wrote `site/public/prices.html`, and I didn't change `build.js`.

**The page lists 6 products.** The cheapest is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |

`products.json` has 10 products in total, but the page only shows the 6 marked active. Two of the inactive ones are cheaper than the pencil set: Juniper soap at 5.90 and Ember tea tin at 7.20. They aren't on the page, so they don't count as the cheapest listed product.
